KMB_2006_p70__paragraph_2.ocr:
During the fourth quarter of 2005, the Corporation acquired Microcuff GmbH, a privately held medical
device and technology company in Germany, for approximately $16 million. This acquisition will further
enhance the Corporation’s Health Care business’ position as a leading global provider of innovative and
technologically advanced medical devices.
